ALSO NEW

MiniMax's fast, low-cost M-series reasoning model with a 1M-token context window. Accepts text, image and video input, and is built for coding, multi-step agent workflows and visual understanding.
Try MiniMax M3.1 Flash (https://aimlapi.com/models/minimax-minimax-m3-1-flash?utm_source=mailchimp&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20261019_new_models&utm_content=minimax&utm_source=AI%2FML+API+Customers&utm_campaign=6c8c13ae1b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_10_19_04_46&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6c8c13ae1b-1373035900)

Subiect: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, MiniMax M3.1 Flash and 3 more new models are here

Conținut:
A 1M-context reasoning model from DeepSeek, a fast low-cost MiniMax Flash model, and three more ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

AI/ML API AI/ML API


** DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, MiniMax M3.1 Flash and 3 more new models are here
------------------------------------------------------------

New reasoning and multimodal models from DeepSeek, MiniMax, Elorian, Reflection and Unbiased.

Hi,

Five new models went live on AIMLAPI today. Same API key, no new setup.

FEATURED · DEEPSEEK AI

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash

DeepSeek's latest Flash build: a 1M-token context chat and reasoning model with thinking mode on by default and image understanding. DeepSeek reports it surpasses V4 Pro on performance, cost and speed.

• 1M-token context window

• Up to 384K output tokens
Try DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (https://aimlapi.com/models/deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017?utm_source=mailchimp&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20261019_new_models&utm_content=deepseek&utm_source=AI%2FML+API+Customers&utm_campaign=6c8c13ae1b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_10_19_04_46&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6c8c13ae1b-1373035900)

ALSO NEW

MiniMax M3.1 Flash

MiniMax's fast, low-cost M-series reasoning model with a 1M-token context window. Accepts text, image and video input, and is built for coding, multi-step agent workflows and visual understanding.
Try MiniMax M3.1 Flash (https://aimlapi.com/models/minimax-minimax-m3-1-flash?utm_source=mailchimp&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20261019_new_models&utm_content=minimax&utm_source=AI%2FML+API+Customers&utm_campaign=6c8c13ae1b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_10_19_04_46&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6c8c13ae1b-1373035900)

Glimpse

Elorian's multimodal visual reasoning model, built for visual understanding and complex reasoning in the physical world. It reasons directly over images and video.
Try Glimpse (https://aimlapi.com/models/elorian-glimpse?utm_source=mailchimp&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20261019_new_models&utm_content=glimpse&utm_source=AI%2FML+API+Customers&utm_campaign=6c8c13ae1b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_10_19_04_46&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6c8c13ae1b-1373035900)

Beam 1.0

Reflection's open-weight reasoning model for coding and long-horizon agentic workflows. A sparse mixture-of-experts with 501B total and 23B active parameters, working over a 1M-token context.
Try Beam 1.0 (https://aimlapi.com/models/reflection-beam-1-0-501b-a23b?utm_source=mailchimp&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20261019_new_models&utm_content=beam&utm_source=AI%2FML+API+Customers&utm_campaign=6c8c13ae1b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_10_19_04_46&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6c8c13ae1b-1373035900)

Pareto 26.10

Unbiased's multimodal composite model built for research, coding and agentic workflows, delivering frontier-level performance across a broad range of general-purpose tasks.
Try Pareto 26.10 (https://aimlapi.com/models/unbiased-pareto-26-10?utm_source=mailchimp&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20261019_new_models&utm_content=pareto&utm_source=AI%2FM
